controls.name: C-21d
controls.query:
FROM logs-postgresql*
| WHERE host.name == "db-1" AND @timestamp >= "2026-07-06T20:00:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-07T00:00:00.000Z"
| STATS count = COUNT(*) BY data_stream.dataset
| SORT count DESC
